name: Bag on Head
author: davcap
bootlegger: All players have the same Zenomancer goal: guess your character before you die. (One attempt per game)
The Fortune Teller receives a "0" when both players chosen do not register as the Demon, and a "1" when either player chosen registers as the Demon.
The Chambermaid may choose themself, but might get incorrect info.
The Sailor and Lycanthrope may choose a dead player. If the Lycanthrope chooses a dead player, it cannot stop the Demon from killing.
The Demon does not learn who the Lunatic is or who they choose.
If an outsider becomes the Fang Gu, they do not learn this.
